団.meaning: Inside a big <part>cage</part>, a whole crowd of golfers squeezes in together, each one swinging a <part>golf club</part>. They wear matching shirts and cheer as one. Nobody plays alone here: they're a <kanji>group</kanji>.
団.on: The cage is deep in a <sound>dun</sound>geon, so they practise in the dark.
団.kun: In the dark they bump into a <sound>ca</sound>rp, a <sound>ta</sound>co, a <sound>ma</sound>ma bear and a <sound>ree</sound>f shark, and all huddle into one ball: a lump.

神.meaning: At night a <part>lamppost</part> lights up a strange <part>monkey sign</part> hung in the clouds, a box with a stake through its middle. Lightning crackles from it and a booming voice laughs. It belongs to the <kanji>gods</kanji>.
神.on: One of the gods trips over the lamppost and bangs a <sound>shin</sound>.
神.kun: Up on a cloud, the gods' cat lies <sound>ca</sound>lm and gives a long '<sound>Mee</sound>-ow.'

失.meaning: A <part>husband</part> is carrying the wedding ring up the aisle when a <part>slash</part> of wind knocks it out of his hand. It bounces once, twice, and drops down a drain. Gone. He's managed to <kanji>lose</kanji> it.
失.on: He searches under every bed <sound>shee</sound>t in the house, just in case.
失.kun: '<sound>Oo</sound>!' he wails, a <sound>shee</sound>p bleats, and his <sound>na</sound>an goes cold while he looks.

治.meaning: A queen stands on a <part>pedestal</part> in the middle of a wild river and lifts her hand. The <part>water drops</part> stop splashing, the waves lie flat and the floods go home. Now she will <kanji>reign</kanji> over the river.
治.on: Her royal guard is a <sound>chee</sound>tah that runs laps around the pedestal.
治.kun: A sick goat nibbles a <sound>na</sound>an from her hand, then jumps up: '<sound>Oh</sound>! I'm better!'

調.meaning: Before his <part>speech</part>, a singer runs one <part>lap</part> of the stage, plucking each string of his guitar and twisting the pegs as he goes. Too sharp, too flat, just right. He has to <kanji>tune</kanji> it first.
調.on: His tight <sound>cho</sound>ker squeaks every time he hits a high note.
調.kun: A <sound>shee</sound>p in a detective hat inspects every string, then cheers '<sound>Rah</sound>!'

呂.meaning: Two <part>mouth</part> boxes stack one on top of the other, joined by a tiny <part>slash</part> of a link, like two bones in your back. Add more and more, and you can bend and twist: it's a <kanji>spine</kanji>.
呂.on: A <sound>ro</sound>dent climbs your back, bone by bone, like a ladder.
呂.kun: A <sound>se</sound>tter dog walks the length of your back and plants a <sound>bo</sound>nsai at the top, beside a fishing <sound>ne</sound>t.

険.meaning: A <part>campsite</part> clings to a cliff edge, tents pegged onto a narrow ledge, and a <part>pennant</part> flaps from a pole hammered into the rock. Look down: a sheer drop. The path up was <kanji>precipitous</kanji>.
険.on: A dog <sound>ken</sound>nel sits on the very edge, swaying in the wind.
険.kun: A <sound>ke</sound>ttle slides off the ledge, and all the campers cry '<sound>Wah</sound>!'
